description: ACCDB: 4nfc TransactionalDdlOverlay — SQL CREATE TABLE + INSERT + SELECT + DROP TABLE inside Workspace.BeginTrans: Phase 1 (Rollback): BeginTrans -> CREATE TABLE TD1 -> INSERT 2 rows -> SELECT (sees 2 rows) -> INSERT Base -> DROP TABLE TD1 -> SELECT TD1 (3078) -> CREATE TABLE TD2 + INSERT + SELECT -> Rollback -> verify TD1/TD2 gone & Base reverted; Phase 2 (CommitTrans): BeginTrans -> CREATE TABLE TC1 + INSERT 2 rows + SELECT -> CREATE TABLE TC2 + INSERT 1 row -> DROP TABLE TC1 -> SELECT TC1 (3078) & TC2 -> CommitTrans -> verify on read-only reopen. Keeps ALL file pages before and after every step and Close.

INSERT INTO Base VALUES (1, 100)
CREATE TABLE TD1 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TD1 PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(20))
SELECT ID, S FROM TD1 ORDER BY ID

INSERT INTO TD1 VALUES (2, 'two')
SELECT ID, S FROM TD1 ORDER BY ID
INSERT INTO Base VALUES (2, 200)
DROP TABLE TD1
SELECT ID, S FROM TD1 ORDER BY ID

INSERT INTO TD2 VALUES (10, 1000)
